projects.title: Zotcade
projects.description:
- Started Zotcade as a project to build a community of gamers at the University of California, Irvine through large scale LAN parties.
- For Zotcade 2013 we raised over $2000 in funding, and attendance of 300 participants.
- For Zotcade 2014 we raised over $5000 in funding, and attendance of 500 participants, with new records on our Twitch stream 2,000 simultaneous, and 35,000 unique over the weekend.

projects.title: AmbiLite
projects.description: AmbiLite is a low-powered smart house ambient light system that promotes a better and a healthier lifestyle using the positive psychological effects of colors on health and behavior. The project consisted of an HTML Mobile App designed by Kyle Copeland that speaks to a Flask Framework Python server built by Lanvi Nguyen. Deanna Yee worked on the Arduino microcontrollers that receive requests from the server to execute on the RGB LED light modules designed by Catherine Africa.
